description:
Can you find your Hawaiian Shirt and sandals?  It’s time for Huli Huli chicken, some pineapple in your diet and time with your friends. There will be a short awards ceremony (emphasis on short) and an outrageous good time for all. This is a party!  It’s your chance to have a great time with your fellow sailors, enjoy a cocktail or two and reflect on a great year. 
Friday, November 6
th    
  
Registration Closes Monday, November 1
st
 
5 PM Social
6 PM Dinner
LINK TO TROPICAL TICKETS (https://www.regattanetwork.com/clubmgmt/applet_storefront.php?regatta_id=31934&clear_session=1)
 

Gate code both events: 1922
